County Health Index 2023
U.S. counties · 2023

County Health Index

Each county scored 0 to 10, with equal weight on the age-adjusted premature death rate (under 75) and on access to care (primary care physicians, pooled with neighboring counties, and the uninsured rate under 65). Hover or tap a county for its score.

Health index score
Less healthyHealthier

Zoom with the buttons, a trackpad pinch, Ctrl/⌘ + scroll, or double-click. Drag to pan.

Scores use fixed 2010–12 goalposts, so a county's score can be compared across years. Rank is out of 3,143 counties (1 = healthiest). Alaska and Hawaii are moved and resized. Gray = not scored.

Sources: CDC WONDER (deaths), HRSA Area Health Resources File (physicians), Census SAHIE (insurance) and Population Estimates.
